capabilities: Publish marked notes and media to a Quartz repository over Git
Precompile changes on vault updates so publishing is instant
Preview compiled diffs before publishing in split or unified view
Manage a Quartz v5 site's configuration, plugins, and upgrades
Automate publishing and site tasks with 22 CLI commands
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool; the name refers to syncing notes one-way from the vault to a Quartz website repository, never back into the vault.
extras: Setup, usage, and troubleshooting guides live in an external documentation site rather than the README. Quartz v4 repositories get publishing only; site management, custom task characters, and URL casing behavior are v5-only. Writes are one-way from vault to repository, and access tokens are encrypted with electron.safeStorage on desktop.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Publish, for inspiring me to create a similar solution for Quartz.
motivation: The author credits Obsidian Publish for inspiring 'a similar solution for Quartz' and built most of the plugin on top of Obsidian Digital Garden.
problem: Obsidian Publish only serves notes on Obsidian's own hosting, so Quartz site owners need a way to select, compile, and push vault notes to their own Quartz repository.

relations.evidence: managing and publishing notes to Quartz, the fast, batteries-included static-site generator
Obsidian Digital Garden, on top of which most of this plugin was initially built.

requires.name: Git provider account (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, etc.)
Quartz v5 site repository (v4 supported for publishing only)

summary: Publishing manager that sends marked vault notes to a Quartz static-site repository over Git, with diff preview, site management, and CLI automation.
